items.text: Rams WR Puka Nacua (calf) officially active vs. Raiders after optimistic reports and feeling better Saturday.
items.why: Calf injury; DNPs but sources optimistic no setbacks; McVay minor designation.
items.implication: Full WR1 role expected in late window; high ranking confidence rewarded.
items.opportunity: Primary target share with Adams out.

items.text: Jets RB Breece Hall (quad) officially inactive after unlikely-to-play reports; limited participant, bit early in return.
items.why: Quad strain after three missed games; not full participant.
items.implication: Backup RBs elevated for full workload vs. MIA.

items.text: ETR Sunday summary: Puka GTD/optimism, Breece GTD/pessimism, Saquon expected, Jacobs/Coleman/Kirk/Mason/Dell/Sampson IN, Lamar/Smith/Wicks OUT, Mike Washington GTD.
items.implication: Projections updated; direct fantasy pivots on statuses.
items.opportunity: Beneficiaries on outs; full roles on INs.

items.text: Eagles WRs DeVonta Smith and Dontayvion Wicks ruled out for Monday Night vs. Cowboys.
items.implication: Concentrated targets to remaining pass-catchers; A.J. Brown/Goedert upside.
items.opportunity: Elevated snap/target share for healthy WRs/TEs.

items.text: Ravens ruled out Lamar Jackson (high ankle sprain) vs. Bengals; Tyler Huntley set to start again.
items.why: High ankle sprain; limited practice then downgraded Saturday.
items.implication: Huntley starts third straight; Ravens offense limited without dual-threat QB.

items.text: Christian McCaffrey went to locker room (thigh) then returned; questionable to return briefly.
items.why: Thigh issue mid-game; cleared to continue.
items.implication: Monitor workload rest of game; no long-term apparent.

items.text: Bucs QB Baker Mayfield active (thumb) with protective glove; returns after missed games.
items.implication: QB1 back; boosts TB pass catchers.

items.text: Eagles RB Saquon Barkley questionable but expected to play Monday vs. Cowboys.
items.why: Hamstring recovery; listed Q but positive reports.
items.implication: RB1 volume if active; monitor final status.

items.text: Giants RB Cam Skattebo expected to resume lead back role vs. Texans; JJ McCarthy long leash.
items.why: Sources confirm return to featured role.
items.implication: High carry/target share in favorable spot.
items.opportunity: Lead RB snaps, carries, potential goal-line.

items.text: Packers activated RB Josh Jacobs from exempt list; expected to play Sunday.
items.implication: Lead back workload; post-layoff rust possible but volume secure.
items.conflict: Berry noted post-layoff caution in some contexts.

items.text: Berry: Jonah Coleman will be the Broncos RB you wish you had; roster in 100% of leagues.
Berry ranks Puka high in top-10 overall Week 7 (around 3); confirmed active post-ranking; strong faith despite Friday DNP.
Lamar, Puka, Breece statuses crucial to Sunday DFS main slate; sneaky scratches include Egbuka, BRob, Warren; projections fully updated on latest news.
items.why: Key variables for slate construction; missed scratches impact depth.
items.implication: Adjust lineups/projections immediately on final statuses.
items.opportunity: Value on backups if scratches hold.

items.text: Tempted to buy CMC lining up more in slot amid 49ers dire WR injuries (Evans/Deebo out) despite usual skepticism of RB-as-WR hype; Kaelon Black presence noted.
items.why: WR room depleted; CMC smile/comment on gameplan.
items.implication: Potential route/target bump beyond standard RB usage.

items.text: Emeka Egbuka OUT (among sneaky scratches noted by Levitan); impacts TB depth.
items.implication: More volume to remaining TB WRs if Mayfield back.

items.text: Berry loves A.J. Brown Week 7 for usage and matchup (vs CHI or similar favorable).
Berry loves Tucker Kraft (TE buffet vs DET defense allowing TE TDs/points).
Berry hates Rome Odunze (shadow coverage expected, limited production history).
items.why: Likely shadowed outside by elite CB; low floor.
